approach: Retroactive plan: PickerPane gets a variant prop (full/shipping) picked by a live isInstantiated() subscription; shipping variant shows read-only base provenance plus a Change-base control that only navigates back to choose_base (no in-place mutation); resolveOutputKeyboardId is the single id source for both the download aria-label and the emitted filename.

decisions.decision: PickerPaneVariant prop on the existing PickerPane, default full
decisions.why: identity/KMN slots already shared between cold-arrival and ship-time cases, and FR-005 requires a mid-visit variant flip to reconcile in place without unmounting a half-typed identity form
decisions.rejected: a second sibling component (ShippingPane) duplicating the shared slots

decisions.decision: variant selection via live useWorkingCopyStore isInstantiated() subscription
decisions.why: a mount-once read reintroduces the exact D1 bug (pickerMode never re-reading the store) one level up, missing the documented late-instantiation settle race
decisions.rejected: computing the variant once from a route/navigation event

decisions.decision: Change base keyboard is a pure navigation action (backToChooseBase + navigateTo), never a mutation
decisions.why: spec Out-of-scope forbids reworking the window.confirm rebase dialog, and a second confirm surface on Output would duplicate confirmRebaseTo at choose_base, reopening the D4-shaped drift-by-prose problem
decisions.rejected: a richer in-place confirm modal on Output replacing window.confirm for this entry point

decisions.decision: new backToChooseBase store action rewinding history to the pre-choose_base prefix, rather than advance("choose_base")
decisions.why: the navigation is conceptually a BACK but choose_base is not the immediate predecessor, so single-step popHistory cannot express it; a forward advance would leave stale steps on the stack so a later Back would walk forward through the survey the author just left (FR-007)
decisions.rejected: generalizing backToUnfinishedGallery target union; that actions docstring documents a different desktop-first jump-past semantics

decisions.decision: single resolveOutputKeyboardId helper in its own module, called by both OutputScreen and serializeWorkingCopy
decisions.why: D4 was two independent derivations of the same id kept in agreement by prose not code; a standalone module (not exported from serializeWorkingCopy.ts) avoids being read as undefined in the two test files that vi.mock that module wholesale
decisions.rejected: correcting the aria-label derivation in place, which would just be a second independent expression that happens to currently match

decisions.decision: Treated this implement step as verification-only since tasks.md is a retroactive record of already-shipped work (feature landed on main before this specs/ directory existed, per the 2026-08-18 spec-number-collision cleanup)
decisions.why: Every task box was already checked with a real file/symbol/FR citation; re-implementing would duplicate shipped code
decisions.rejected: Re-running /speckit-tasks or re-authoring the changes as if new

FR-003.title: Variant selection MUST be derived from a live store subscription, not a mount-once read

FR-004.title: Reduced variant MUST present the base keyboard as read-only provenance with a programmatically-associated label

FR-005.title: Reduced variant MUST keep TrackOneIdentityPanel and KmnEditor rendering and editable across a variant flip

FR-006.title: Reduced variant MUST offer a Change base keyboard control that navigates to choose_base and never mutates the working copy

FR-007.title: choose_base back-navigation MUST leave history free of stale forward entries

FR-008.title: Download aria-label MUST derive the keyboard id from the same source as the emitted filename

FR-009.title: All new/changed user-visible strings MUST be Lingui-wrapped per the §046 convention

FR-010.title: No new debounce timer, validation cycle, or working-copy mutation path may be introduced
